name: Tokyo Love Story
source:
Mai and Sayuri graduate from high school. Mai enters a college, and Sayuri goes to a four-year university in Tokyo. Together with Yuuichi they rent a flat in Tokyo and start their communal living.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
麻衣和小百合高中毕业。麻衣进入大学，小百合进入东京的一所四年制大学。他们和雄一一起在东京租了一套公寓，开始了共同生活。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
